item.title: Research Associate (PostDoc)
item.description:
• Research within the DFG Cluster of Excellence „Responsible Electronics in the Climate Change Era (REC²)“ under the direction of the chair.
  • Research in the field of RF-photonics and plasmonics to realize the objectives of the project that could include simulations, design, and measurements.
  • Collaborate within the cluster and within the chair’s group and contribute to IP and publications.

item.title: Research Associate (PostDoc)
item.description:
• Research within the ERC project ELEPHANT (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/948624) under the direction of the chair.
  • Research in the field of integrated photonics and on-chip photonic circuits to realize the objectives of the project, which could include simulations, design, and laboratory setups and measurements.
  • Collaborate within the chair’s group and contribute to IP and publications.
